tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Find g4rden's growing guides by place name, or the nearest guides to a latitude/longitude. Returns slugs to use with the other tools. Covers 1,000+ cities worldwide.

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: A city's growing guide as Markdown: average last and first frost dates (from a nearby weather station where there is one), the frost-free season, hardiness zone, climate, and the crops that suit it.

tools.name: what_to_plant
tools.description: What to start indoors, sow outdoors or plant out in a given city and month, as Markdown, from that city's own frost dates. Months with nothing new to sow say so and point to the next sowing month.

tools.name: frost_outlook
tools.description: The next 10 nights' forecast lows for a city with any frost or near-frost nights, and today's soil temperature (top 7 cm) against the sowing thresholds (hardy seed 10 °C; beans, corn, squash 15 °C). From ECMWF open data, updated twice a day; a regional forecast for the city, not a particular garden.

tools.name: get_plant
tools.description: How to grow a plant (vegetable, herb, fruit or flower) as Markdown: spacing, sun, water, timing relative to frost, companions and pests.

tools.name: get_pest
tools.description: A garden pest or disease as Markdown: how to recognise it, which plants it attacks, and a treatment ladder from least to most drastic. Covers 46 common pests and diseases with treatment advice and about 390 plant-health records (host plants, where recorded, regulatory status) by common or scientific

tools.name: planner_link
tools.description: A link that opens g4rden's free garden planner already set to a city or location, for the person to open themselves. Creates nothing: the person decides whether to make an account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_city" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
